name: 36117 · Montgomery, AL
findings: ZIP 36117 (Montgomery) has 229 nonprofit organizations. 99 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 84 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 36117 (Montgomery) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 36117 (Montgomery) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 5.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
